title: Business Analyst
text: Business Analyst at Takeda Pharmaceuticals Australia Pty Ltd (Sydney, CBD, Inner West & Eastern Suburbs; Full Time; salary: not stated). About Takeda At Takeda, we work as a team to provide better health and brighter futures for all. As a global pharmaceutical company, Takeda focuses on discovering, developing and delivering innovative medicines that can have a life-changing impact for patients worldwide. In fact, patients are at the center of everything we do. We encourage our 30,000+ employees to continuously develop their skills, and we reward them for the results they achieve. We value integrity, dedication and teamwork, which are abundant in our multinational workforce. If you want to make a difference, if you want to be inspired, if you want to do important work—join us. The Position Business Analyst The focus of this role is to provide analysis, insight and data to key stakeholders across the business, including the Commercial, Finance and Sales teams. It is expected that this position will apply primary & secondary data to facilitate fact-based decision making, with the intent of optimizing the performance of existing and new products. You will need: Tertiary qualification in a discipline that includes a significant analytical component (e.g. science, economics, business, statistics). Min. of 3 to 5 years of work experience in an analytical role. Experience within the pharmaceutical / healthcare industry is preferred. Candidates who have not worked in the industry will be considered on the basis of their experience and learning agility. Advanced knowledge in Microsoft Office suite (esp. Excel and Powerpoint). Experience with other analysis software and data systems will be well regarded. Role Competencies Analytics & Problem Solving – the ability to gather data/insights and subsequently apply the findings to decision making and the development of action plans. Time Management – the ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously, while meeting the time requirements of stakeholders. Effective written and verbal communication (e.g. the ability to explain complex analysis to non-technical staff). Collaboration – the ability to work well with a wide variety of stakeholders, incl. staff from a variety of functions (e.g. Commercial, Finance, Sales), across various levels within the organization. Resilience – the ability to adapt to the dynamic nature of the business and the needs of various stakeholders. Learning agility. Attention to Detail For a confidential discusion call Michael on 0419 140 304 All applicants must have the relevant visa to work full-time in Australia. If you believe you fit the above criteria, please submit your application via SEEK.
